blocks.text: I can describe and represent {hundredths} as a decimal number.
In this lesson you will learn how to write hundredths as decimals, using a place value chart.
Tap each word to see what it means.

items.def: The name we give to one part of one hundred equal parts.
When a whole is divided into one hundred equal parts, we can say one of those parts is one hundredth the size of the whole.
The hundredths column places the number of hundredths a given number has.

slides.title: 10 times the size, one tenth the size

blocks.text: Look at how these numbers are related.
We can say **10 times bigger** or **10 times the size**. We can say **10 times smaller** or **one tenth the size**.
0.1 is ten times smaller than 1. When a digit moves {one column to the right}, it becomes one tenth the size.
Make a number 10 times smaller, then 10 times smaller again. It has been made **100 times smaller**.
The digit has moved **two columns to the right**. The number is now {one hundredth the size}.

blocks.label: What is one hundredth the size of 1000?
blocks.text: **10**. 1000 → 100 (one tenth the size) → 10 (one tenth the size again).
A place value chart shows the value of each digit. Going right, each column is one tenth the size of the one before.
The {hundredths column} is the column to the right of the tenths column.
The decimal point separates the ones from the fractional parts. If there are no fractional parts, we do not need a zero after the decimal point.
Take 0.1 and divide it into ten equal parts. Each part is one hundredth. So one hundredth is **one tenth the size of a tenth**.
Or take 1 and divide it into one hundred equal parts. Each part is one hundredth. So one hundredth is **one hundredth the size of one**.

rows.note: One tenth divided into ten equal parts: each part is one hundredth.

blocks.text: One hundredth is written as {0.01}. The 1 is in the hundredths column.

slides.title: Quick check: one tenth or one hundredth the size?

items.q: One hundredth the size of 200 is …
One tenth the size of 50 is …
One hundredth the size of 8 is …

blocks.text: One hundredth can be written as 0.01. What about more than one hundredth?

items: 40 hundredths is written **0.40**. We say “zero point four zero” or “zero point four”.
12 hundredths is written **0.12**. We say “zero point one two”.

blocks.label: Why is 12 hundredths written as 0.12?
blocks.text: 10 hundredths make one tenth, so the 1 goes in the {tenths column}. The remaining 2 hundredths go in the {hundredths column}.
Some people write 12 hundredths as 0.012. Is that right?

blocks.label: Tap to find out
blocks.text: No! 0.012 puts the 1 in the hundredths column and the 2 in the next column along. **12 hundredths is 0.12**: ten hundredths regroup into one tenth, and 2 hundredths are left over.
Two-digit hundredths, like 12 or 48, take up {two columns}: the tenths column and the hundredths column.
A ladybird has crawled 48 hundredths the length of a stick.
We write this as **0.48**. You can describe amounts by comparing them to one hundred hundredths (the whole stick).

blocks.q: Match each amount to its decimal.

items.q: 0.7 is the same as how many hundredths?

blocks.q: Look at the digit 4 in each number. Tap a number, then tap the column that says what the 4 is worth.

items: If a digit moves one column to the right, it becomes one tenth the size.
One hundredth is one tenth the size of one tenth, and one hundredth the size of one.
The hundredths column is to the right of the tenths column.
You can write hundredths as decimals. One hundredth = 0.01 and 23 hundredths = 0.23.

blocks.text: Ten hundredths regroup as one {tenth}, so 12 hundredths is {0.12}, not 0.012.

worksheet.title: Worksheet: Describe and represent hundredths as a decimal number
worksheet.instructions: Write your answers as decimals or numbers. Think about which place value column each digit goes in.

questions.explanation: 9 hundredths goes in the hundredths column, with a 0 in the tenths column: 0.09.
37 hundredths is 3 tenths and 7 hundredths, so 0.37.

questions.prompt: Write 5 tenths and 2 hundredths as a decimal.
questions.explanation: 5 in the tenths column and 2 in the hundredths column: 0.52.
94 hundredths is 9 tenths and 4 hundredths, so 0.94.

questions.prompt: What is one hundredth the size of 500?
questions.explanation: Making 500 one tenth the size gives 50, and one tenth the size again gives 5.

questions.prompt: What is one tenth the size of 0.1? Write it as a decimal.
questions.explanation: 0.1 divided into ten equal parts: each part is one hundredth, 0.01.

questions.prompt: What is one hundredth the size of 8? Write it as a decimal.
questions.explanation: 8 is made one tenth the size (0.8), then one tenth the size again (0.08).

questions.prompt: In the number 0.86, how many hundredths are there in total?
Which column is directly to the right of the tenths column? (Write one word.)
questions.explanation: Each column to the right is one tenth the size, so after tenths comes hundredths.

questions.prompt: Write 60 hundredths as a decimal with two digits after the decimal point.
questions.explanation: 60 hundredths is 6 tenths and 0 hundredths: 0.60, which we can also write 0.6.
